title: BIDMC PPG and Respiration Dataset — record 01
population: Earth-based critically ill hospital patient; not an astronaut
publication: Pimentel et al., Towards a Robust Estimation of Respiratory Rate from Pulse Oximeters (2016).
authors: Marco Pimentel, Alistair Johnson, Peter Charlton, David Clifton
license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0
transformations: No resampling, normalization, imputation, filtering, or timestamp rebasing in the source data. HR is monitor-derived from ECG, not assumed resting. Other original CSV columns remain in the raw file and source_fields. Only HR is ingested as a measurement.
storage_time_encoding: Internal SQL datetime = 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z + source elapsed seconds. This is a reversible ordering adapter, NOT a measured calendar timestamp. API/chart/export expose the original elapsed seconds; no calendar recording date or timezone is invented.
physionet_citation: Pollard et al. (2026), PhysioNet as a global platform for biomedical research.
